method.slope: Horn 3x3 gradient on the DEM at 14.29 x 14.27 m baseline
method.roughness: standard deviation of elevation in a 3x3 window (rock-abundance proxy)
method.no_data: cells outside the HiRISE stereo swath are classed no-data and barred

classes.label: Nominal traverse
classes.detail: Slope under 15 degrees and low local relief.

classes.label: Caution: slope 15-25 deg or rugged
classes.detail: Above the 15 degree slope flight rule, or detrended local relief over 1.0 m. Traversable at a cost penalty.

classes.label: Slope > 25 deg
classes.detail: Above the suited-crew limit. Barred by the planner.

classes.label: Broken ground
classes.detail: Detrended local relief over 2.2 m. A ruggedness index, not a rock count: at ~14 m/px the DEM cannot resolve individual boulders.

classes.label: No stereo coverage
classes.detail: Outside the HiRISE stereo swath. No terrain knowledge, so the planner will not route here.
